# torr

## Tools for Tall om Rapporter in R

This package offers functions designed to simplify and standardize
analyses related to *Tall om* reporting nationally and internationally.
It supports reproducible workflows, ensures compliance with established
reporting standards, and enables seamless automation of recurring
analytical tasks.

## Installation

You can install *torr* package directly from Github:

``` r
if(!require(pak)) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("folkehelsestats/torr")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`create_cann_pop()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/create_cann_pop.md)
  : Create Cannabis Population Indicators

- [`create_codebook()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/create_codebook.md)
  : Create an interactive codebook using DT

- [`create_narko_pop()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/create_narko_pop.md)
  : Create Population Indicators for LTP and LYP Variables

- [`create_narko_pop_vec()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/create_narko_pop_vec.md)
  :

  Apply
  [`create_narko_pop()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/create_narko_pop.md)
  Over Multiple Specifications

- [`extract_attr()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/extract_attr.md)
  : Extract variable metadata from a dataset

- [`group_age()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/group_age.md)
  : Categorize Age Variable into Groups

- [`group_age_standard()`](https://github.com/folkehelsestats/torr/reference/group_age_standard.md)
  : Create Standard Demographic Age Groups
